india6.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke asked people to force the leaders of political parties to work for education first and then come to seek votes

india6.title: Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker rightly dropped disqualification proceedings against 21 AIADMK MLAs: Madras High Court
india6.description: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan refuse to issue a direction to the Speaker to initiate the proceedings against all 25 AIADMK MLAs who voted in favour of TVK government

india6.title: UGC equity regulations 2026 under reconsideration: Centre to Supreme Court
india6.description: On January 29, the Supreme Court had directed that the University Grants Commission (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026, be kept in abeyance.

india6.title: Students stage protest in Hassan demanding basic facilities in girls hostel
india6.description: AIDSO district secretary Sushma D.S. said that windows in the hostel, which houses 110 students, opened onto the main road, but did not have curtains, denying minimum privacy to the inmates

india6.title: Tamil Nadu Assembly: ‘Ration rice used as cattle fodder’ remark by Minister Sengottaiyan triggers furore
india6.description: Former Agriculture Minister M.R.K. Panneerselvam said even former Minister K.N. Nehru had been consuming ration rice.

india6.title: Supreme Court scraps worker-friendly 1978 ‘industry’ precedent for new labour code
india6.description: ‘Industry’ under Industrial Relation Code will be interpreted in its ‘own text and context’, says top court; the 1978 verdict had enabled workers employed in a wide range of jobs to have a legal recourse, including collective bargaining, against unfair labour practices by employers

india6.title: Pension income ceiling enhanced to ₹1.20 lakh, set to benefit over 20 lakh persons in Karnataka
india6.description: The scheme covers old-age pensions, widow pensions and disability pensions, and the existing income ceiling had been capped at ₹32,000

india6.title: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong meets Sitharaman-led ministerial delegation, discusses ways to deepen bilateral ties
india6.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is leading a ministerial delegation to participate in the 4th India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable (ISMR) on August 19-20

india6.title: BJP disrupts Karnataka Assembly demanding list of drought-hit taluks, exit of B. Nagendra from Cabinet
india6.description: Leader of Opposition R. Ashok said the government had neither reviewed the situation nor prepared a list of taluks facing severe drought following a deficit monsoon

india6.title: Bank employee kills wife, sister before shooting self in Lucknow
india6.description: The incident took place outside an ICICI Bank branch in Gomti Nagar where the wife worked as a relationship manager; police said the accused was reportedly experiencing marital discord

india6.title: Muttil tree-felling case: Kerala High Court dismisses Roji Augustine’s plea to stay trial
india6.description: Court directs him to approach trial court – Chottanikkara Judicial First Class Magistrate Court in Ernakulam – on the matter

india6.title: Ready to give all water to Tamil Nadu from new dam at Mullaperiyar, says V.D. Satheesan
india6.description: At South Zonal Council Meeting, V.D. Satheesan also urges Union government to annul the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2026,

india6.title: Southern Zonal Council meet: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay seeks fair, equitable treatment of southern States from Centre
india6.description: At the 31st meeting of the Southern Zonal Council held at Mamallapuram and presided over by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, Mr. Vijay said the southern States have consistently been among the principal drivers of the nation’s economic growth

india6.title: Four higher education Bills passed in Andhra Assembly; land norm for private universities eased
india6.description: The four Bills, passed unanimously, restrict the regulatory commission to fee regulation, cut the minimum land for private universities to 10 acres in cities, allow skill universities, and provide for university-level faculty recruitment with reservation safeguards

india6.title: Bhubaneswar drivers' protest: 113 arrested, 354 vehicles seized over violence, says Police
india6.description: So far, seven FIRs have been registered against the protesters at Kharvel Nagar police station in this connection with the violence

india6.title: Deliveries at Keralam’s Kozhikode Government Women and Children’s Hospital decline
india6.description: According to Health department, there were a total of 5,201 deliveries (2,729 normal and 2,472 C-section) in 2020-21. This number came down to 2,238 (1,387 normal and 851 C-section) in 2025-26. A large number of people from the urban areas of Kozhikode are dependant on the hospital

india6.title: No motive behind circular on student participation in CJP, Left parties’ protests: Tamil Nadu Higher Education Minister
india6.description: The Minister’s statement comes after a now-withdrawn directive issued by the Higher Education Department, which had sought coordinated action to prevent students from participating in protests organised by the Left parties and CJP

india6.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay extends greetings on World Photography Day
Sajjan Kumar, former Congress MP convicted in anti-Sikh riots case, passes away
india6.description: Sajjan Kumar was sentenced to life imprisonment by the Delhi High Court on December 17, 2018, in a case related to the murder of five Sikhs during the 1984 anti-Sikh killings

india6.title: DVAC conducts searches in EB offices in Tamil Nadu
Papa looking down proudly at his beautiful Sonia: Rahul's emotional note on mother's memoir
india6.description: “I am happy, and so proud, that your story — ‘Belonging: A Journey of Love’ — will finally be read by the millions of people who love you. I know how hard it was for someone as private as you to tell the world your beautiful story,” Rahul Gandhi said

india6.title: CPI(M) holds Tamil Nadu Chief Secretary responsible for  circular on student participation in Left parties’ protests
india6.description: Mr. Shanmugam contended the meeting (where the decision to curb protests was taken), attended by the Chief Secretary, had denied students their right to protest.

india7.title: NCERT reconstitutes Class 11, 12 Political Science textbook team; four members have RSS links
india7.description: NCERT has reformed its Class 11 and 12 Political Science textbook teams, aiming to integrate cultural rootedness and Indian knowledge. At least four members have RSS or BJP links, with deadlines set for November and next July. *Suggested Headlines:** NCERT Revises Political Science Textbooks RSS Lin

india7.title: NTA overhaul: Four-tier paper checking, new experts and CISF security for offices
india7.description: The NTA is undergoing a significant overhaul, including a four-tier question paper check, removal of 600 experts, induction of new specialists, and CISF security, following recent examination controversies.

india7.title: UAE accuses Iran of launching 2 ballistic missiles targeting maritime traffic
india7.description: UAE air defences intercepted two Iranian ballistic missiles targeting maritime traffic; both fell at sea. The UAE condemned Israeli strikes in Syria separately.

india7.title: Jharkhand govt cancels 44 recruitment exams amid protests; appointed candidates challenge move
india7.description: Jharkhand cancelled 44 recruitments since 2014 over irregularities. Protesting candidates demand investigations, not outright cancellation of their appointments. A CID probe is widening, with arrests made. The government promises reforms to restore confidence.

india7.title: How to estimate gold loan repayments with a digital gold loan calculator
india7.description: A gold loan calculator estimates repayments and compares options, aiding financial planning before applying for a gold loan. It provides an estimate only.

india7.title: Trump says Iran should surrender, rules out deal extension; threatens to bomb Oman
india7.description: President Trump stated Iran would not reach a necessary deal to end conflict, urging surrender, while confirming no extension of a prior stalled interim agreement concerning their nuclear programme.

india7.title: Students may call off protest as Jharkhand govt cancels all recruitment exams
india7.description: Jharkhand's government cancelled all recruitment tests, including the JSSC-CGL exam, due to alleged irregularities, aiming to satisfy protesting students and reform the system.

india7.title: NTA removes over 50 staffers, begins overhaul after UGC-NET row
india7.description: Following examination errors, the NTA removed over 50 staff and is overhauling its system. New professionals and stricter protocols are being implemented, with re-examinations scheduled for three subjects.

india7.title: SC asks Allahabad HC not to proceed with disproportionate assets case against Rahul Gandhi
india7.description: The Supreme Court has instructed the Allahabad High Court to halt proceedings on a disproportionate assets case against Rahul Gandhi, directing agencies like the CBI and ED not to submit reports.

india7.title: Senior Citizen Tribunal can evict children to protect elderly parents: Supreme Court
india7.description: Tribunals can evict children from properties to protect elderly parents, ensuring their safety and dignity as per the 2007 Act, the Supreme Court clarified.

malay2.description: 1984 ലെ സിഖ് വിരുദ്ധ കലാപവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട് അഞ്ചു പേരുടെ മരണത്തിനിടയാക്കിയ കേസിൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം തടവിന് ശിക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ട മുൻ കോൺഗ്രസ് എംപി സജ്ജൻ കുമാർ 80-ാം വയസ്സിൽ ഡൽഹിയിലെ സഫ്ദർജംഗ് ആശുപത്രിയിൽ അന്തരിച്ചു. ആരോഗ്യനില വഷളായതിനെ തുടർന്ന് തിഹാർ ജയിലിൽ നിന്ന് ആശുപത്രിയിലെത്തിച്ചെങ്കിലും ജീവൻ രക്ഷിക്കാനായി

malay2.title: ശ്രീരാമന്റെ ഉദ്ദേശം വേറെ; പുലിയാവാൻ വരട്ടെ എന്ന് ഇന്നലെയും ആ പയ്യൻ ചോദിച്ചു; പുലിക്ക് ‘വയർ’ മാത്രം പോര
malay2.description: കേരളത്തിന്റെ ഓണാഘോഷങ്ങൾക്ക് ചന്തം പകരുന്ന തൃശൂരിലെ പുലിക്കളിയെ കലാ വൈകൃതം എന്നു വിശേഷിപ്പിച്ച നടൻ വി.കെ ശ്രീരാമനെതിരെ വിമർശനം ഉയരുന്നു. പുരുഷന്മാർക്കു മാറും വയറും വളരുന്നതു രൂപ വൈകൃതമാണെന്നും കലയ്ക്കുവേണ്ടി വൈകൃതത്തെ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നത് ആഭാസമാണെന്നുമാണ് വി.കെ. ശ്രീരാമൻ ഫെയ്സ്ബുക്കിൽ കുറിച്ചത്. ശ്രീരാമൻ

malay2.title: പ്രധാനമന്ത്രിയെ അപമാനിച്ചെന്ന കേസ്; മേക്കപ്പ് ആർട്ടിസ്റ്റ് ജാൻമണി ഉൾപ്പെടെ 3 പേർ അറസ്റ്റിൽ
malay2.description: കോഴിക്കോട് ∙ പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി നരേന്ദ്ര മോദിയെ അപകീർത്തിപ്പെടുത്തുകയും അപമാനിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന പരാമർശം നടത്തിയെന്ന കേസിൽ മേക്കപ്പ് ആർട്ടിസ്റ്റ് എറണാകുളം തേവര കോന്തുരുത്തിയിൽ ജാൻമണി ദാസ് (48) ഉൾപ്പെടെ മൂന്നു പേർ അറസ്റ്റിൽ. കോഴിക്കോട് സൈബർ സിറ്റി പൊലീസാണ് ജാൻമണിയുടെയും പരാമർശം വന്ന വിഡിയോ പകർത്തുകയും അത്

malay2.title: ‘പെട്ടുപോയതാണ്... റിയാലിറ്റി ഞാൻ പറയാം’; വടകര എംഡിഎംഎ കേസിൽ അറസ്റ്റിലായ അധ്യാപിക
malay2.description: കോഴിക്കോട് ∙ വടകര എംഡിഎംഎ കേസിൽ റിമാൻഡിലായ കാവ്യ, നീഷ്മ എന്നീ അധ്യാപകരെ കോടതി രണ്ടു ദിവസത്തെ പൊലീസ് കസ്റ്റഡിയിൽ വിട്ടു വടകര എൻഡിപിഎസ് കോടതിയാണ് വെള്ളിയാഴ്ച വൈകിട്ട് നാലു മണി വരെ ഇവരെ കസ്റ്റഡിയിൽ വിട്ടത്. ഇരുവരെയും ഒന്നിച്ചിരുത്തി ചോദ്യം ചെയ്യാനാണ് പ്രത്യേക അന്വേഷണ സംഘം(എസ്ഐടി) ഒരുങ്ങുന്നത്.

malay2.title: നിലയ്ക്കലിലെത്തി 10 സെക്കൻഡ്, നിലത്തിറക്കാതെ മടങ്ങി; വ്യോമസേനയുടെ ഹെലികോപ്റ്റർ വന്നതെന്തിന്?
malay2.description: ശബരിമല നിലയ്ക്കലിലെ ഹെലിപാഡിൽ ഒരു വ്യോമസേന ഹെലികോപ്റ്റർ ഇറക്കാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചെങ്കിലും, നിലത്തിറക്കാതെ 10 സെക്കൻഡിനു ശേഷം തിരികെ പറന്ന സംഭവം പൊലീസ് അന്വേഷണത്തിന് വഴിവെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. ഈ ഹെലികോപ്റ്റർ എത്തിയതിന്റെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യവും ഇറക്കാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചതിന്റെ കാരണവും വ്യക്തമല്ല. മുമ്പ് ശബരിമല സന്നിധാനത്തിന് മുകളിലൂടെ അ

malay2.title: വീട് നിർമാണം: തടസ്സമായ വൈദ്യുതലൈനും പോസ്റ്റും മാറ്റാം; കെഎസ്ഇബി നൽകും 50,000 രൂപ വരെ
malay2.description: ലൈഫ് മിഷൻ, പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ആവാസ് യോജന പദ്ധതികളിലെ ഗുണഭോക്താക്കൾക്ക് വീടുനിർമ്മാണത്തിന് തടസ്സമാകുന്ന വൈദ്യുതി ലൈനുകളും പോസ്റ്റുകളും മാറ്റുന്നതിന് 50,000 രൂപ വരെ സഹായം നൽകുന്ന കെഎസ്ഇബി പദ്ധതി പുനരാരംഭിച്ചു; 2027 മാർച്ച് 31 വരെ കാലാവധിയുള്ള ഈ പദ്ധതിയുടെ പ്രധാന മാറ്റം, ഭൂമി ഉടമസ്ഥാവകാശത്തിൽ ഇളവ് വരുത്തിയത

malay2.title: ശ്രീരാമന്റെ ആക്ഷേപം സങ്കടകരം; പുലിക്കളി പണ്ടേ ഇഷ്ടം, 24 ലക്ഷം ഇന്നലെ നൽകിയെന്ന് സുരേഷ് ഗോപി
malay2.description: നടൻ വി.കെ. ശ്രീരാമൻ പുലിക്കളിക്കെതിരെ നടത്തിയ പരാമർശങ്ങളിൽ അതിയായ ദുഃഖം പ്രകടിപ്പിച്ച് കേന്ദ്രമന്ത്രി സുരേഷ് ഗോപി രംഗത്തെത്തി. തൃശൂർ പൂരത്തിനൊപ്പം വലിയ ജനാവലിയെ ആകർഷിക്കുന്ന പുലിക്കളിയെ ഒരു കലാവൈകൃതമായി കാണാൻ കഴിയില്ലെന്നും, ഇത്തരം കലാരൂപങ്ങൾക്ക് കേന്ദ്രസർക്കാർ ഉൾപ്പെടെ ധനസഹായം നൽകുന്നത് അതിന്റെ പ്ര

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’

bang3.title: Rajapaksa ally elected Lanka president
bang3.description: Six-time prime minister Ranil Wickremesinghe was elected as crisis-wracked Sri Lanka’s new president by the country’s parliament yesterday, with the backing of the party of the ex-leader -- who fled abroad after his palace was stormed by protesters.

ca3.description: Quebec City’s Islamic Cultural Centre issued a safety reminder to its members following a number of incidents of vandalism and online harrasment impacting Muslim communities in the province this past year.

ca3.title: Expecting Ontario moms are travelling hours for routine ultrasounds amid sonographer shortage
ca3.description: Some expecting parents in Ontario are struggling to schedule routine ultrasound appointments due to growing waitlists and a shortage of sonographers. There is a 20 per cent sonographer vacancy rate in the province, according to Sonography Canada.

ca3.title: 'I was meant to be there': Off-duty Mountie helps rescue baby, family trapped in house fire
ca3.description: RCMP Const. Anton Lorde had finished his shift and was on his way home when he saw dark smoke billowing into the sky. His quick response — along with the actions of a family member — helped save the lives of four people.

ca3.title: N.L. couple donates hundreds of trees to Conception Bay North one year after wildfires
ca3.description: The Town of Small Point-Broad Cove-Blackhead-Adam's Cove was ravaged by multiple wildfires last summer, but it may soon look a little greener — thanks to a couple who donated over 450 trees to the community.

ca3.title: Invasive plants are available across Canada. Is federal regulation possible?
ca3.description: Several Canadian cities are pursuing bylaws to restrict the sale of invasive plants by garden centres and nurseries. Advocates with the Canadian Coalition for Invasive Plant Regulation say a federal horticulture body and invasive plant database would help a biodiversity crisis in the making.

ca3.title: Proposed changes to endangered species law would 'stab it to death,' says scientist
ca3.description: The former chairs of a panel that advises the federal government on endangered wildlife have published an open letter highlighting concerns over proposed changes to the Species At Risk Act, which they say could lead to the "wilful extinction" of endangered species in Canada.

ca3.title: N.L. premier says referendum on Churchill Falls axed due to Ottawa partnership, U.S. tariffs
ca3.description: Newfoundland and Labrador Premier Tony Wakeham says political circumstances are behind his decision to forgo putting a new Churchill Falls deal to the public as previously promised.

ca3.title: A cold spring delayed P.E.I. sweet corn. Now farmers face cheaper competition from Quebec
ca3.description: After a cold spring that slowed growth, Prince Edward Island’s corn season is now catching up — just as cheaper product from Quebec is arriving in grocery stores.

ca3.title: RCMP officer who fatally shot Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation man declines to testify at inquest
ca3.description: It took less than five minutes between two RCMP officers arriving in the remote island First Nations community of Opitsaht and when the shots that killed Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation man Julian Jones were fired, according to one of the officers.

ca3.title: Once a leader in $10-a-day child care, B.C. now lags behind: report
ca3.description: British Columbia is lagging behind other provinces when it comes to universal affordable child care, according to a new report from the Canadian Centre for Policy Alternatives. Of the 35 cities studied in the report, the five B.C. cities are the most expensive.

ca3.title: Woman fined after grizzly bear run-in with off-leash dog in Banff National Park
ca3.description: An encounter between a couple with an off-leash dog and a well-known grizzly bear in Banff National Park resulted in a $1,500 fine, after a video of the counter generated millions of views on TikTok.

ca3.title: B.C. pitcher Tugboat Wilkinson ready to set sail on major league career
ca3.description: San Francisco Giants pitching prospect brings a notable nickname and "burning desire to beat you," according to his former coach.

ca3.title: Missing pilot found dead in aircraft submerged in lake, Ontario police say
ca3.description: A pilot who has been missing since Friday has been found dead after searchers discovered his small aircraft underwater in the Kawartha Lakes region this week, Ontario Provincial Police say.

ca3.title: Ottawa bagpiper says unprovoked knife attack won't keep him from playing
ca3.description: Kevin Murison was busking in downtown Ottawa on Saturday when a man assaulted him with a knife, slashing his thumb and his instrument. The bagpiper says he won't be silenced.

ca3.title: Majority of Canadians say they won't buy American alcohol if it becomes available again
ca3.description: According to a recent Nanos Research poll, 69 per cent of Canadians said they would continue to boycott American alcohol even if it returns to Canadian stores.

ca3.title: Fake maple syrup class action now targeting major grocery store chains
ca3.description: A proposed class-action lawsuit targeting a Quebec producer who sold fake maple syrup has expanded, alleging grocery store chains should have known the product they were selling was bogus.

ca3.title: Ottawa police detective who accessed files on infant deaths handed 2-year demotion
